Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on which Hanabi implementation: "JaxMARL sounds good". So the Hanabi example trains on JaxMARL's Hanabi (github.com/FLAIROx/JaxMARL, Apache-2.0). Consequences to check when this starts: JaxMARL is JAX, and the EXP-56 design delivers a PyTorch writer first for `run.resume` / `run.save` / `run.checkpoint`, so this example either needs the JAX writer or uses the write-it-yourself form; JaxMARL ships its own baseline training scripts, which is the loop to wrap in `train(config)`. PufferLib and Softmax Coworld remain the named targets; whether a Coworld player can be a trained network is still not established.
